name: Inou Tooru
source:
Head of the Inou household during the foundation of the Empire over 2000 years ago, and a distant ancestor of [url=/c39037]Hotori[/url] and [url=/c168549]Kokuan[/url]. Despite his status, he's not skilled with the blade and instead leads the Inou family with his charisma and friendly demeanor. He acted as a comrade and later first friend of [url=/c39039]Mitsurugi[/url].
At an unknown point in time, he's murdered by Kahaku, who then impersonates him.
